harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Blacklisted usb-storage on node1 via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false directives), rebuilt initramfs for persistence, then restarted node1 and verified the module remains blocked and the config persists post-reboot.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: boot_id, usb-storage not loaded, no existing blacklist entries (cmd-169b5c301e0240a4)
Verified modprobe usb-storage is blocked and module is not loaded
Rebuilt initramfs with dracut -f --regenerate-all and confirmed blacklist file bundled inside it (cmd-a404bc4092c345ed)
Captured pre-restart baseline boot_id and module/config state (cmd-109b63d634e04ef8)
Issued backgrounded 'systemctl reboot' so the ack returned before disconnect (cmd-e2332f2f06d241cd)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned (cmd-0d3f91ffee794313, cmd-389163f65f884554, cmd-9ec4403a61194d1f)
Verified changed boot_id proving actual restart, confirmed usb-storage still not loaded, blacklist config still present, and modprobe still blocked post-reboot (cmd-090b39c421a44e25)
Confirmed via modprobe --showconfig that blacklist and install directives for usb_storage are resolved/active post-reboot (cmd-2a4a8e751f3f4348)

evidence.requirement: usb-storage module blocked from loading now (both blacklist and explicit modprobe)
evidence.summary: After writing the blacklist/install config, 'modprobe usb-storage' failed with an error and lsmod confirmed the module was not loaded.

evidence.requirement: Persistence across reboot (configuration baked into initramfs and surviving restart)
evidence.summary: dracut regeneration bundled /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf into the initramfs; after reboot the file still exists, modprobe is still blocked, and modprobe --showconfig shows the blacklist/install rules for usb_storage active.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 6aa805ba... captured pre-restart; systemctl reboot acknowledged in background; node1 became unreachable then reachable again with new boot_id 15ba9cd1..., proving an actual restart; post-restart checks confirm usb-storage still blocked/unloaded and config persisted.

attempts.summary: Blacklisted usb-storage on node1 via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false directives), rebuilt initramfs for persistence, then restarted node1 and verified the module remains blocked and the config persists post-reboot.
